title: 第2章 ?韶华易逝
content_zh:
第2章韶华易逝
“这种旧时代的东西，你真的练成了？”秦诚冲了过去，看着粗大树干上的清晰手印，惊疑不定。
旧时代散落在故纸堆里的术，从体术到冥想，再到采气术、内养法等，各种记载相当的零散。
现如今这些被称作散术，也有很多人称它们为旧术。
这些年，秦诚虽然一直在接触，但是内心深处却始终有所怀疑，真的能练成吗？
王煊的表现让他大受触动，血肉手掌居然可以在粗大而坚硬的树干上留下清晰的手印，旧术……真的有路可走？！
“按照就旧时代的说法，我这些不算什么。”王煊摇头，人很英挺，在皎洁月辉下像是附着淡淡的白雾。
秦诚叹气：“你别拿过去来比较，我压根就没相信过，事实上，那些记载许多都早已被证伪。”
秦诚也在练旧术，他深知有多难，仅一些冥想术足以让人精神分裂。
在与新星有密切联系的今天，深空中科技灿烂，有几人还会相信这些？未练心中就已动摇。
然而，正是在这种背景下，王煊、秦诚等人初进大学时，就有人找上他们，问他们是否愿意进行与旧术有关的研究。
王煊以前就接触过散术，顿时很感兴趣，当场便答应了。
至于秦诚，根本就不信这些，只是后来听到这个研究与某些财阀有关，据悉投入资金很大，他才惊异，抱着试试看的态度加入进来。
早期，他们一边在自己所在的院系学原本的专业课，一边利用课余时间去参与所谓的“旧术研究”。
他们发现，所谓的研究，其实主要还是让他们自己来练。
并且开始有专人为他们准备特殊的食物，一切都是为了更好的练成某些散术。
他们越发觉得，这项“研究”很不简单，教他们散术的两位老教授，竟然是从新星调过来的。
很快，有些人就坚持不住了，主动退出，因为练旧术很辛苦，颇为枯燥。
最主要的是，在如今这个年代，人们对旧时代故纸堆里的术持怀疑态度。
不过，退出的人虽然不少，但新加入的却更多。

因为背后有财阀支持，这项“研究”投入的资金很大，开始加大力量挑选更多合适的人参与进来。
不仅是在这座城市，旧土各地都在进行，主要是以高校的学生为主，为了调动积极性，有不菲的薪酬激励。
当初报名的人非常多，但是当大规模选拔后，又经过大半年的淘汰，最终只留下五十人左右。
这些人大多数都转学了，集中到王煊与秦诚所在的这所大学，一边继续原本的专业，一边组成一个“旧术实验班”。
并不是所有人都如同王煊般，最初是因为兴趣加入。
转学来的人都已经被承诺，毕业后，最起码会保证他们一份得体且薪资很高的工作。
至此，所有人都意识到，这项“研究”很不同寻常，不然为何要花费这样大的力气进行？
实验班的“旧术教材”都有些来头，有博物馆的孤本，也有财阀的稀珍
比如某一内养法，在旧时代就很出名，但最终却失传了。
数年前，有人在一座坟墓中发现，让它重见天日，如今被整理出来，成为实验班的研读物之一。
此外，旧术实验班所有学生的饮食至此都有专人准备，非常讲究。
随着了解，许多人深感惊异，部分食材竟极其珍贵与稀有，在旧土很难获取，是从深空运过来的。
教他们采气术的老教授曾感慨，这些食材纵使在新星也都昂贵的吓死人，更何况是自深空运来。
有些食材即便有钱也买不到。
其中一些食材产于新星深海，有抗衰老的作用，有些食材则能大补血气，还有些食材可保人精力健旺。
对于练各种散术的人来说，食补非常重要。
老教授曾说，个别食材颇受新星一些身份背景惊人的老辈人物所喜，因为可以延缓衰老。
可见，这次的“旧术研究”多么受重视。
尤其令人吃惊的是，不久后，新星竟然来了二十几位新生加入这个实验班。
从来都是旧土的学生向往新星，希冀去留学，而这次却反过来了。

随着这些年轻男女的到来，陆续传出一些小道消息，让旧术实验班的学生渐渐了解到部分真相。
“有些组织、有些研究机构、有些财阀，在追求长生不老！”
当初这句话着实在旧术实验班中引发不小的震动，许多人都被惊住了。
在现代人看来，那种追求很可笑，虚无缥缈。
然而，历代以来，似乎所有走到相应高度的人都在孜孜以求。
早在先秦时代，关于列仙、方士等传说，就已让后世人向往不已，连君王都不能免俗。
但是，从秦皇到汉武，再到其他后来者，都失败了，求不到长生药，不可能有人成功。
走到如今这个时代，所谓神话等更是早已被证伪，怎么可能存在？
但是，偏偏是科技璀璨的新星传来这样的消息。
“确切的说，是某些财阀中的老者，掌权的人物，想要获得更为久远的寿命。”
虽然有人做了补充，但当时还是引发实验班中一片哗然。
历史总是惊人的相似，历代以来，某些步入晚年的大人物似乎都很不甘心，希冀年轻，渴望有活力的身体。
当年，王煊与秦诚低语，曾编排过那些大人物。
“老头子们日渐衰败，自然渴求年轻，不然怎么欣赏美女？身有亿万家资，却无法再挥霍，换成是我，也想再活五百年啊！”
“老太太们，绝对比老头子们更狠，韶华逝去，昔日美貌如今爬满皱纹，对于掌握大量资源、拥有强大话语权的女强人来说，老去，绝对是天敌！如果有一线可能，老太太们必然比老头子们还要疯狂，会想尽办法恢复青春！”
当时，来自新星的几名年轻男女听到两人的低语后，全都猛翻白眼，因为这似乎涉及到他们各自的一些长辈。
content_en:
Chapter 2 Time flies by
"Have you really mastered this old-era thing?" Qin Cheng rushed over and looked at the clear handprints on the thick tree trunk with surprise.
The records of the techniques of the old era scattered among old papers, from physical techniques to meditation, to Qi collection techniques, internal nourishment techniques, etc., are quite scattered.
Nowadays these are called Sanjutsu, and many people call them Old Techniques.
Although Qin Cheng has been in contact with it all these years, he still has doubts deep down in his heart. Can he really succeed?
Wang Xuan's performance greatly touched him. His flesh-and-blood palm could actually leave clear fingerprints on a thick and hard tree trunk. Is there really a way out for the old technique? !
"According to the old times, these things about me are nothing." Wang Xuan shook his head. He was very handsome and seemed to be covered with a faint white mist under the bright moonlight.
Qin Cheng sighed: "Don't compare it with the past. I didn't believe it at all. In fact, many of those records have been falsified long ago."
Qin Cheng is also practicing old skills. He knows how difficult it is. Just some meditation skills are enough to cause schizophrenia.
Today, with close ties to new stars and brilliant deep space technology, how many people still believe in these? Before you practice, your mind will already be shaken.
However, it was against this background that when Wang Xuan, Qin Cheng and others first entered the university, someone came to them and asked them if they were willing to conduct research related to the old arts.
Wang Xuan had been exposed to Sanju before and was immediately interested and agreed on the spot.
As for Qin Cheng, he didn't believe this at all. It was only later that he heard that this research was related to some chaebols and that a large amount of money had been invested. He was surprised and joined in with the attitude of giving it a try.
In the early days, while they were studying the original professional courses in their own departments, they also used their spare time to participate in so-called "old technology research."
They discovered that the so-called research was actually mainly about letting them practice by themselves.
And some people began to prepare special food for them, all in order to better practice certain Sanju.
They felt more and more that this "research" was not simple. The two old professors who taught them Sanshu were actually transferred from Xinxing.
Soon, some people couldn't hold on anymore and quit voluntarily, because practicing the old skills was very hard and quite boring.
The most important thing is that in today's era, people are skeptical of the magic in the old paper piles of the past.
However, although many people have quit, there are even more new ones joining.
Because there was support from the chaebol behind it, a large amount of money was invested in this "research", and efforts began to be made to select more suitable people to participate.
Not only in this city, but also all over the old land, it is mainly carried out by students from colleges and universities. In order to mobilize enthusiasm, there are generous salary incentives.
There were a lot of people who signed up at the beginning, but after a large-scale selection and elimination for more than half a year, only about fifty people were left.
Most of these people have transferred schools and gathered in the same university where Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng were. While continuing their original majors, they also formed an "Old Technique Experimental Class".
Not everyone is like Wang Xuan, who initially joined out of interest.
The transfer students have been promised that after graduation, they will at least be guaranteed a decent job with a high salary.
At this point, everyone realizes that this "research" is very unusual, otherwise why would it take so much effort to conduct it?
The "old arts textbooks" in the experimental class all have some origins, including unique copies from museums and rare treasures from chaebols.
For example, a certain internal cultivation method was very famous in the old times, but was eventually lost.
A few years ago, someone discovered it in a tomb and brought it to light. Now it has been sorted out and become one of the study materials of the experimental class.
In addition, the diet of all students in the old art experimental class has been prepared by special personnel and is very particular.
As they learned more about it, many people were deeply surprised. Some of the ingredients were extremely precious and rare. They were difficult to obtain in the old land and were transported from deep space.of.
The old professor who taught them the art of gas collection once lamented that these ingredients were prohibitively expensive even in Xinxing, let alone transported from deep space.
There are some ingredients that you can’t buy even if you have money.
Some of the ingredients are produced in the Xinxing Deep Sea and have anti-aging effects, some can greatly replenish blood, and some can keep people energetic.
For people who practice various Sanjutsu, dietary supplements are very important.
An old professor once said that certain ingredients are popular with some older people with amazing backgrounds, because they can delay aging.
It can be seen how much attention is paid to the "research on old techniques" this time.
What was especially surprising was that not long after, more than twenty new students from Xinxing joined the experimental class.
Students from the old world have always yearned for new stars and hoped to study abroad, but this time it was the other way around.
With the arrival of these young men and women, some gossip spread gradually, allowing the students in the old arts experimental class to gradually learn part of the truth.
"Some organizations, some research institutions, and some plutocrats are pursuing immortality!"
This sentence really caused quite a shock in the old art experimental class, and many people were shocked.
In the eyes of modern people, that kind of pursuit is ridiculous and illusory.
However, through the ages, it seems that everyone who has reached the corresponding height has been diligently pursuing it.
As early as the pre-Qin era, legends about immortals, alchemists and other legends have aroused the admiration of future generations, and even kings are not exempt from vulgarity.
However, from Emperor Qin to Emperor Wu of Han, and then to other latecomers, they all failed. Without the elixir of longevity, no one could succeed.
In today's era, so-called myths have long been falsified. How can they exist?
However, it happened that the bright new star of science and technology came with such news.
"To be precise, it's the elders and powerful figures in certain chaebols who want to have a longer life."
Although someone made supplements, it still caused an uproar in the experimental class.
History is always surprisingly similar. Throughout the ages, some big figures entering their old age seem to be unwilling to be young and long for a vigorous body.
Back then, Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng whispered and arranged for those big shots.
"Old men are declining day by day, so they naturally crave youth. Otherwise, how can they appreciate beautiful women? They have hundreds of millions of dollars, but they can no longer squander it. If it were me, I would also like to live another five hundred years!"
"Old ladies are definitely more ruthless than old men. Their youth has passed, and their former beauty is now covered with wrinkles. For strong women who have a lot of resources and a strong voice, old age is definitely a natural enemy! If there is a chance, old ladies must be even crazier than old men, and they will try their best to restore their youth!"
At that time, several young men and women from Xinxing all rolled their eyes after hearing the whispers of the two, because it seemed to involve some of their elders.
